Use the Saint-Venant isentropic flow relations, not the Rayleigh-Pitot formula, for subsonic flow at M = 0.5.
Take γ = 1.4 for air.
Compute T₀/T = 1 + ((γ − 1)/2) · M².
Compute p₀/p = (T₀/T)^(γ/(γ − 1)).
Compute ρ₀/ρ = (T₀/T)^(1/(γ − 1)).
Evaluate these expressions at M = 0.5 and γ = 1.4.
Report T₀/T = 1.05.
Report p₀/p ≈ 1.186.
Report ρ₀/ρ ≈ 1.130.
Do not apply the Rayleigh-Pitot formula at M = 0.5.
